paper_title: Thinking Slow, Fast Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
caption: : Coverage.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the coverage achieved by different models as a function of the number of completions, with the x-axis representing the number of completions on a logarithmic scale ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$, and the y-axis showing coverage values from 0.3 to 0.9. The plot includes four distinct lines: Llama-3B (blue circles), Llama-3B + FT (green triangles), Llama-1B (light blue diamonds), and Llama-1B + FT (light purple inverted triangles). All models exhibit an increasing trend in coverage as the number of completions increases. Specifically, Llama-3B starts at a coverage of approximately 0.43 and rises to about 0.9, while Llama-3B + FT begins slightly higher at around 0.45 and reaches a peak of approximately 0.91. Llama-1B starts at roughly 0.32 and increases to about 0.86, and Llama-1B + FT begins at approximately 0.33 and reaches a maximum coverage of around 0.88. The coverage for all models appears to plateau as the number of completions approaches $2^8$.
